docs.title: Diego Augusto dos Santos Brabo
docs.text:
Staff Cloud & Reliability Engineer

Building cloud platforms that make engineering teams more resilient, autonomous, and effective.

Get in touch ↗ Connect on LinkedIn

● São Paulo, Brazil · Portuguese (native) · English (elementary)

docs.title: Profile
docs.text: Cloud and reliability engineer with 20+ years in IT, from data center migrations to building cloud platforms and GenAI tooling at Santander Group's technology company. I build self-service platforms that engineering teams adopt: AWS foundations (SSO across 478 accounts, Terraform-based IaC that cut infrastructure delivery from weeks to minutes) and a resilience engineering platform used by 333 engineers. I speak on resilience engineering, mentor engineers, and set product direction. Working toward Principal Engineer.

docs.title: Expertise
docs.text:
• Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, Azure, Terraform, Atlantis, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes (Amazon EKS), landing zones, AWS SSO, EC2 autoscaling
  • Reliability & Resilience: SRE practices, Chaos Engineering (Litmus Chaos, AWS FIS), load testing (k6)
  • GenAI & Automation: Python, Bash, OpenAI, RAG, CI/CD
  • Leadership: technical ownership, mentoring, internal speaking, project and delivery management

docs.title: F1RST Digital Services (Santander Group) · São Paulo
docs.text:
Engaged since July 2018, through Indra Brasil and Motivus Brasil, and as a direct employee since October 2020.

IT Engineer Expert · May 2026 – Present

  • Technical owner of the resilience engineering platform (333 active users); set the product vision and roadmap, ensure ongoing operation, and mentor a team of 3 engineers.
  • Speaker at 4 internal events on resilience engineering (about 200 attendees each) and contributor to F1RST's Resilience Academy video series.

IT Engineer Specialist · Nov 2021 – Apr 2026

  • Built from scratch a self-service resilience testing platform (Litmus Chaos, AWS FIS, k6, Python) that uses generative AI to analyze results and recommend improvements.
  • Built the backend of F1RST's first GenAI assistant for incident support (Python, OpenAI, RAG), used by about 6 support teams.
  • Built Terraform modules and automation that cut infrastructure delivery from weeks to minutes, with prebuilt images and autoscaling; automated EC2 autoscaling for the Apigee environment.
  • Administered Amazon EKS clusters while building the Terraform modules that provisioned them.
  • Implemented AWS SSO (from about 30 teams to 478 accounts today) and IaC with Atlantis, which ran in production for about two years before moving to GitHub Actions.

IT Senior Analyst · Jul 2018 – Oct 2021

  • Owned end-to-end infrastructure delivery from requirements and architecture design through production.
  • Supported project management for the Pix rollout, delivered on schedule with no incidents.

docs.title: Perfil
docs.text: Engenheiro de cloud e confiabilidade com mais de 20 anos de experiência em TI, de migrações de data centers à construção de plataformas de nuvem e ferramentas de GenAI na empresa de tecnologia do Grupo Santander. Desenvolvo plataformas self-service adotadas pelos times de engenharia: fundações AWS (SSO em 478 contas, IaC com Terraform que reduziu a entrega de infraestrutura de semanas para minutos) e uma plataforma de engenharia de resiliência usada por 333 profissionais. Também palestrante sobre resiliência, mentor de engenheiros e responsável pela direção de produto da plataforma. Em desenvolvimento para atuar como Principal Engineer.

docs.title: Especialidades
docs.text:
• Cloud e infraestrutura: AWS, Azure, Terraform, Atlantis, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes (Amazon EKS), landing zones, AWS SSO, autoscaling de EC2
  • Confiabilidade e resiliência: práticas de SRE, Chaos Engineering (Litmus Chaos, AWS FIS), testes de carga (k6)
  • GenAI e automação: Python, Bash, OpenAI, RAG, CI/CD
  • Liderança: ownership técnico, mentoria, palestras internas, gestão de projetos e delivery

IT Engineer Expert · Mai 2026 – atual

  • Palestrante em 4 eventos internos sobre engenharia de resiliência (cerca de 200 participantes por evento) e colaborador da série de vídeos da Resilience Academy da F1RST.

IT Engineer Specialist · Nov 2021 – Abr 2026
